'''Cerberus''' is a dog-like monster that dwells in the entrance of the underground passageway to [[Canifis]]. You are required to kill Cerberus in the [[Priest in Peril]] quest. Cerberus cannot be killed before being told to do so as there is no 'Attack' action available. It can only be killed once, after which it is replaced by another dog named [[Lycurgus]].

==Trivia==
* Previously, he was named the Temple Guardian.
* Previously, trying to attack it after the quest gave you the message "I'd better not to make the King mad at me again!".
* In Greek mythology, {{wp|Cerberus}} is the name of the three-headed dog that guards the gates to the Underworld.
